mostWorthwhile.text: Making the hydrothermal vent was most worthwhile: it explained how seawater circulates through hot rock and how chemical differences can supply energy on the dark seafloor.

surprise.text: Earth and water made pigment rather than advancing mineral transport, a surprising detour toward a future painter.
